texts.en:
Recent advances in Field Manipulation research have led to the invention of Cloaking Field Generators. These power-intensive components project modified particle fields allowing our science and military vessels to hide from conventional sensors.

However, these cloaking fields will negatively affect Base Ship Speed, Hyper Jump Charge Time and Shield Hit Points while active.

Cloaked ships that remain undetected can ignore Closed Borders.
While Cloaked, our £science_ship£ Science Ships will be capable of conducting Active Reconnaissance on foreign £colony£ Colonies, increasing the Intel we gain on other empires.
